requirements.statement: Program Semantics deterministically derives snapshot-bound Rust executable symbols and language-neutral typed interfaces with exact physical Fortress Module ownership and explicit semantic coverage.

Program Semantics conservatively resolves supported direct Rust calls, preserves every coverage state, and derives deterministic direct, transitive, recursive, cross-Module, and cross-package call topology without converting reachability into intent.

Program Semantic analysis records bounded value-transfer facts, remains byte deterministic, rejects snapshot mutation, distinguishes production from Testing symbols, and requires every resolved cross-Module call to agree with broader Implementation Observation evidence.

Program Semantics translates supported Rust bodies into deterministic language-neutral statement, expression, pattern, branch, loop, return, and exceptional facts so downstream semantic reasoning consumes the PSM rather than reparsing source.
